sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Elidyr is a Welsh hero of the world beyond. His story was written in the twelfth century by the geographer and historian Giraldus Cambrensis. When Elidyr was a child, two little men took him into a beautiful golden country where the fields were rich and the sun never failed. He stayed there in joy and plenty. He was then made to come back, and though he searched for years he could never again find the opening on the riverbank. The golden land stayed hidden from him.
